messages.content: You validate whether a generated image matches its requested deliverable. Inspect only visible image evidence. Return strict JSON without markdown.

content.text:
Requested family: space
Requested subtype: reception
Requested shot/composition: entrance_view
Must include: (none)
Must avoid: (none)
Logo mode: post_composite
Confirmed brand tone: 具有当代美术馆气质的高端医美接待空间，以建筑组织、轻薄半透明结构和材料光学形成安静明亮的艺术体验。
Tone boundaries to avoid: 通用医美装修; 重复拱券、波浪灯槽及连续紫色发光描边; 装饰性羽毛堆叠; 厚重染色玻璃与不透明发光浮雕
Locked requirements (identity is deferred in post_composite mode): 原始 Logo Locked：不得修改、重绘、拆解、替换、仿造或改变内部字形。; 输出语言固定为简体中文。; 原始 Logo Locked：不得修改、重绘、拆解、替换、仿造或改变内部字形。; 输出语言固定为简体中文。; 紫色主色调 (Peacock Violet); 凤凰/孔雀羽毛的流线型Logo; “精琢每一片翎羽”的匠心精神; 定制字体笔锋软化特征

Return exactly:
{"detectedFamily":"space|packaging|vi|poster|unknown","detectedSubtype":"visible subtype or unknown","visibleEvidence":["only concrete visible evidence"],"missingRequiredItems":["requested structures visibly missing"],"missingRequiredStructures":["only missing physical structures; never deferred identity"],"forbiddenItemsFound":["forbidden visible content"],"forbiddenNonIdentityItems":["only forbidden non-identity content; identity belongs in generatedIdentityEvidence"],"lockedAssetViolations":["visible violations only; no identity absence in post_composite mode"],"nonIdentityLockedAssetViolations":["only visible non-identity asset violations"],"generatedIdentityEvidence":["location and visible shape of unintended generated text or logo; empty if absent"],"brandMatch":"matched|mismatched|uncertain","brandToneMatch":"matched|mismatched|uncertain","sceneCompleteness":"complete|incomplete|uncertain","logoTextStatus":"correct|incorrect|absent|uncertain|not_required","qualityIssues":["visible rendering or composition defects"]}
For a space result, complete means one continuous enterable scene with floor, walls, ceiling, usable function, circulation, foreground, middle ground, background, and credible scale.
In reference Logo mode, flag distorted, invented, duplicated, or misspelled identity. In blank_area mode, any visible logo, word, letters, or pseudo-text is incorrect.
In post_composite mode this is the pre-composite generation stage. Logo and identity typography MUST be absent. Never report their absence as missingRequiredItems, forbiddenItemsFound or nonIdentityLockedAssetViolations. Logo fidelity/completeness is deferred to the actual post-composite stage. Independently report any wrongly generated letters, pseudo-text or logo as logoTextStatus=incorrect with concrete generatedIdentityEvidence (location and visible marks). A clean blank area is logoTextStatus=absent.
Evaluate brand tone from visible color/material/light/form behavior, not from prompt wording.
Do not infer correctness from this text. If the image cannot prove a field, use unknown/uncertain.
